description: Show a sample of Nuvidian P1's 'Today's 10' deck built from fictional Florida agents, so a human can see what the product does before signing up. Call it when someone asks 'what is P1?' or 'show me'. The cards are unmistakably fake (555-01xx phones, @example.com emails, brokerages ending in  ' (demo)'), scored and sorted like a real deck. Show the cards in order with score and the plain-English 'why' line, then read out the note: it says this is a public sample and how to start a free workspace. Nothing is written and nobody is contacted.

n.description: How many sample cards to show (1-20, default 10).

name: p1_practice_deck
